name: 06877 · Ridgefield, CT
findings: ZIP 06877 (Ridgefield) has 149 nonprofit organizations. 69 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 57 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06877 (Ridgefield) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06877 (Ridgefield) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
